mapper.select: /* SQL ID : MsgPushDAO.selectPushRcvnDtl 설 명 : 푸시 수신 상세 조회 */ SELECT S.MSG_MBL_SNDNG_ID , S.MSG_ID , S.SNDNG_TTL , S.SNDNG_CTS , S.SNDNGNM , S.SNDNGR_ID , S.SNDNG_DTTM , T.READ_DTTM , S.RCVR_ID , T.RCVRNM , MSG.TTL , MSG.TXT_CTS , MSG.SBJCT_ID , SBJCT.SBJCT_YR , SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM AS SBJCT_SMSTR , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SC.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , USR.STDNT_NO , (SELECT S8.SNDNG_PHNNO FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S8 WHERE S8.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID AND S8.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SNDNG_PHNNO FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S INNER JOIN TB_LMS_MSG MSG ON S.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_MSG_RCV_TRGTR T ON S.MSG_ID = T.MSG_ID AND S.RCVR_ID = T.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON MSG.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON SC.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON S.SNDNGR_ID = USR.USER_ID WHERE S.MSG_MBL_SNDNG_ID = #{msgMblSndngId} AND S.RCVR_ID = #{rcvrId} AND S.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND S.RCVR_DELYN = 'N' AND NVL(S.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN S.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) = 'SCS'
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : MsgPushDAO.updatePushReadDttm 설 명 : 푸시 읽음 처리 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_MSG_RCV_TRGTR SET READ_YN = 'Y' , READ_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE MSG_ID = (SELECT MSG_ID FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG WHERE MSG_MBL_SNDNG_ID = #{msgMblSndngId}) AND USER_ID = #{rcvrId} AND READ_YN = 'N'
mapper.select:
/* SQL ID : MsgPushDAO.selectPushSndngDtl 설 명 : 푸시 발신 상세 조회 */ SELECT MSG.MSG_ID , MSG.TTL , MSG.TXT_CTS , MSG.HTML_CTS , MSG.RGTR_ID AS SNDNGR_ID , MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM , MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_CNCL_DTTM , (SELECT S2.SNDNGNM FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S2 WHERE S2.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID AND S2.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SNDNGNM , NVL( (SELECT MIN(S3.SNDNG_DTTM) FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S3 WHERE S3.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID AND S3.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND NVL(S3.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN S3.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) <> 'RSRV') , MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM ) AS EFCTV_SNDNG_DTTM , CASE WHEN MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM IS NOT NULL AND MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_CNCL_DTTM IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S4 WHERE S4.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID AND S4.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND NVL(S4.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN S4.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) = 'RSRV') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS RSRV_YN , CASE WHEN MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM IS NOT NULL AND MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_CNCL_DTTM IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S6 WHERE S6.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID AND S6.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND NVL(S6.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN S6.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) = 'RSRV') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S7 WHERE S7.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID AND S7.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND NVL(S7.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN S7.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) <> 'RSRV') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FULLY_PENDING_YN , SBJCT.SBJCT_YR , SC.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT AS SBJCT_SMSTR , MSG.SBJCT_ID , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SC.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , (SELECT S8.SNDNG_PHNNO FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG S8 WHERE S8.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID AND S8.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD = #{mblSndngTycd} AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SNDNG_PHNNO FROM TB_LMS_MSG MSG LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON MSG.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON SC.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE MSG.MSG_ID = #{msgId}
AND MSG.RGTR_ID = #{sndngrId}
mapper.delete:
/* SQL ID : MsgPushDAO.deleteRcvTrgtr 설 명 : 수신 대상자 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_MSG_RCV_TRGTR WHERE MSG_ID = #{msgId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_MSG M WHERE M.MSG_ID = #{msgId} AND M.RGTR_ID = #{sndngrId})
